title: the trial install from the tag by runbook 27 alone, on paper (lane H, 2026-11-19)
note: Read from the repository on master a44a39da; nothing was run on a GPU, a VM or the hub. Lane J wrote runbook 27 and owns these; the register has no lane J, so they are filed under D for the integrator to route. The follower (tools/runbook_workstation.py) records each when W-2 runs.

findings.claim: Runbook 27 step 11 on a machine without Maven: deploy/poc.sh builds the Python and JVM images but not trialbox-postgres:16-1, which compose's db service names with no build entry and no registry, so the start stops (fix in #1130, a draft)
findings.expected: the start builds every image it needs, as runbook 28 step 6 does by hand
findings.happened: not run: read in the code; card 24-2 (#1130) states the same fault

findings.claim: Runbook 27 step 1 runs nvidia-smi before step 2 installs Ubuntu and step 4 the driver: on a plain Ubuntu the command is not found
Runbook 27 steps 5 and 7 give no install command, only an outside page (step 7 names NVIDIA's apt steps without an address), so the guide alone cannot be followed there
Runbook 27 step 5 expects docker compose v2.x; the version Docker's page installs today may differ while the start needs only the plugin
